recentItems.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Official Ifuu & Burai Trailer
recentItems.description:
Join Yuriri Naka, voice of the Oni Lady, as she introduces Ifuu and Burai in this latest Onimusha: Way of the Sword trailer for the upcoming action game. Check out the trailer to see Ifuu and Burai in action and learn more about these brothers. Onimusha: Way of the Sword will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on September 4, 2026. A demo is out now.

Ifuu is the younger of the Genma siblings who have made Kennin-ji Temple their lair. He seeks out duels with worthy challengers, alongside his older brother, Burai. Capable of stirring up powerful gales, he wields the wind to blast away his foes.

Burai is the elder of the Genma siblings who have made Kennin-ji Temple their lair. Just like his younger brother, the promise of good fight gets his blood pumping. He fights with the combination of a naginata-like polearm and contraptions that unleash bursts of lightning.

recentItems.description:
Check out this cinematic lore trailer for 1001 Threads of Mizan, the just-announced Arabian fantasy action game where 1-3 players fly around on magic carpets and battle fantastical creatures. It's inspired by the classical tale of One Thousand and One Nights (AKA Arabian Nights) told by Scheherazade.

recentItems.title: Stellar Blade - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Gameplay Video | gamescom 2026
recentItems.description:
Check out 5 minutes of action-packed gameplay from the Nintendo Switch 2 version of Stellar Blade in this video for the post-apocalyptic action-adventure game. recentItems.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered - Official Songs of the Past Gameplay Showcase | gamescom 2026
recentItems.description:
Check out the Songs of the Past Gameplay Showcase for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered, an upcoming DLC and remastered version of the legendary action RPG developed by CD Projekt Red. Players can get an in-depth look at both The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered and the upcoming Songs of the Past expansion, bringing current-gen updates and a new adventure into the new realm of Letten, respectively. Don't miss over 12 minutes of gameplay for both The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered, launching on September 29, and the upcoming Songs of the Past Expansion launching in 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, GoG, Epic Games Store, and Battle.Net).

recentItems.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation: How Weapons & Chadley Are Integrated Into the Story | gamescom
recentItems.description:
The Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy is set to wrap up with 2027s Final Fantasy VII Revelation, and we are excited to finally battle the Weapons. We caught up with Naoki Hamaguchi, Game Director on FF7 Revelation, who gave us insights into how the Weapons are integrated into the story, Chadley's new role in the story, and what exactly he might be doing with all that combat training data...
Final Fantasy VII Revelation is coming in early 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam), and Xbox Series X|S.

recentItems.title: Dreampainters - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026
recentItems.description:
Put your creativity to the test in Dreampainters! Get a fresh look at gameplay and more from Dreampainters in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person puzzle game. Discover the surreal world of an artist's dreams and use a paintbrush to unfold its mysteries with striking colors. Or grab a friend to paint your dreams together in two-player co-op dedicated missions. Dreampainters will be available on PC in 2027. A playtest is out now on Steam, and you can wishlist Dreampainters on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479080/Dreampainters/
